summary: Telegram could not upload the file from its URL.

match_any.description_exact: Bad Request: can't upload file by URL

possible_causes: Generating a file from the supplied URL failed.
diagnostic_limits: The response mapping does not identify the original retrieval or file-generation failure.

evidence.note: File generation failed is rewritten to this description and code 400.
The rewrite runs only after the error is normalized to code 400.
Adds the code-specific prefix and lowercases only the initial character of ordinary messages.

response.description: Bad Request: can't upload file by URL

preconditions: Check the URL and file requirements; use a direct upload if the method supports it and the application can supply the file.
